evidence: docs/stabilization/runs/contained-navigation-004.json preserves the exact result, release receipt, resource policy and admission/watch/exit events before runner edits.

The saved target avatar:admin passed; profile:admin and all admin navigation targets are absent. The saved failure_stage admin_avatar therefore locates the failure after the avatar target and before the Profile target, but not its failing operation.

The runner called click(Profile) then waitFor(profile_selected) with no stage advance or last observation; its catch discarded the error. This reporting defect is proven by the runner source and persisted result.

UserMenu closes the popover and selects profile on Profile click. App renders ProfileView in TabsContent value profile; ProfileView contains the expected header, Identity, First name, and Back control. Source alone does not prove what happened in run 004.

Run 005 on the same 0.2.67 release passed the admin avatar and Profile pointer click; the Profile view observation returned profileHeader=true, identitySection=false, firstNameField=true, backControl=true before the 10-second wait expired.

ProfileView renders <Collapsible label="Identity">. The shared Collapsible renders that label inside button[aria-expanded][aria-controls] with CSS uppercase styling and a controlled region with aria-hidden; the runner had read the mixed-case word through rendered pane.innerText.
diagnosis: Run 005 proves the exact failing predicate was identitySection, after a successful Profile click and other Profile view observations. The prior predicate used case-sensitive rendered innerText despite the Identity label having uppercase styling. The runner now checks the specific expanded Identity collapsible, its controlled region, and aria-hidden=false. A subsequent native run is still required to prove that this oracle repair clears the boundary; no product defect is established.
